data.one_liner: A wrapper around Ably's client library SDKs for real-time messaging on iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to build realtime experiences using Ably's Pub/Sub platform. It supports features like pub-sub messaging, message history, presence, and push notifications.
use_when: You need real-time pub-sub messaging, chat features, or live updates in your Flutter app.
You require message history and presence features managed via Ably's infrastructure.
avoid_when: You are building a basic app with standard REST API requests that do not require real-time websocket synchronization.
You prefer to self-host your own WebSocket or MQTT backend instead of using Ably.
strengths: Backed by Ably's highly performant, reliable, and scalable messaging infrastructure.
Supports robust features including message history, client presence, and push notifications.
weaknesses: Requires using an external paid or freemium third-party service (Ably).
Platform support is limited to Android and iOS according to package specification.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the dependency to pubspec.yaml and setting up Android/iOS minimum version requirements (Android 4.4 / API 19+, iOS 10+).
